title: Fabula Ultima Encounter Builder
description: Build encounters for Project FU from every NPC in your world and compendiums (the Core Rulebook, the Bestiary, the Atlases, your own). Weigh them with the Core Rulebook's soldier count or the Bestiary's level-weighted method, see how hard the fight is, let it suggest one for Easy to Deadly, save encounters, and place them on the scene and into the combat in one click.
